query: How many days do I have to return an item?
reference_answer: 30 days from the date of delivery for most new, unopened, and unworn items.

query: Is return shipping free if I choose store credit?
reference_answer: Yes, returns for store credit are free and the $6.95 return shipping label fee is waived.

query: What is the standard return shipping label fee in the US?
reference_answer: $6.95 flat fee deducted from your refund.

query: Can I return a personalized or custom-engraved item?
reference_answer: No, personalized or custom-engraved merchandise is final sale and cannot be returned.

query: How long does a credit card refund take after approval?
reference_answer: 5 to 7 business days to appear on your statement depending on your bank.

query: How fast is Northstar Store Credit issued after inspection?
reference_answer: Within 2 hours of return inspection approval.

query: Are original expedited shipping fees refunded on a standard return?
reference_answer: No, original expedited or overnight shipping fees are non-refundable unless due to a Northstar Shop error or defective product.

query: What is the minimum order amount for free standard domestic shipping?
reference_answer: $75 or more for free Standard Ground Shipping.

query: What is the cutoff time for same-day order processing?
reference_answer: 2:00 PM EST Monday through Friday.

query: How much does Overnight Express domestic shipping cost?
reference_answer: $29.95 flat rate for orders placed before 1:00 PM EST.

query: Can I ship an expedited order to a PO Box?
reference_answer: No, Expedited and Overnight shipments require a physical street address; only Standard Ground orders under 15 lbs can go to PO Boxes.

query: Which countries does Northstar Shop ship to internationally?
reference_answer: Canada, the United Kingdom, the European Union, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, and Singapore.

query: How long does International Standard shipping take?
reference_answer: 7 to 14 business days.

query: Who pays customs duties on international orders?
reference_answer: The recipient upon delivery, unless Duties & Taxes Prepaid (DDP) is selected at checkout.

query: Why is my tracking number not showing any movement yet?
reference_answer: Carriers can take up to 24 hours after label creation to scan the package and display movement.

query: My package says delivered but I cannot find it. What should I do?
reference_answer: Wait 24 hours, check porches, garages, mailrooms, and neighbors, and contact support within 7 days if still missing.

query: How long do I have to cancel my order after placing it?
reference_answer: Within 1 hour of placing the order.

query: Can I add another item to an order I already placed?
reference_answer: No, we cannot add, remove, or swap items in an existing order. Cancel within 1 hour and place a new order.

query: Do you accept Klarna or Affirm?
reference_answer: Yes, Klarna and Affirm are available on orders over $50 for eligible US residents.

query: How long do pending authorizations from failed payments stay on my card?
reference_answer: They drop off automatically within 3 to 5 business days.

query: Can I stack two promo codes on one order?
reference_answer: No, only one promo code may be applied per order.

query: Do Northstar Shop gift cards expire?
reference_answer: No, digital and physical gift cards never expire and have zero maintenance fees.

query: How long does a password reset link remain valid?
reference_answer: Password reset links expire after 30 minutes.

query: What happens to my rewards points if I delete my account?
reference_answer: Deleting your account forfeits any unused Northstar Rewards points.

query: How long is the warranty on Northstar hardware?
reference_answer: 1-year limited warranty from the original date of delivery.

query: Does the warranty cover accidental drops or liquid spills?
reference_answer: No, accidental damage such as drops, liquid spills, or cracked screens is not covered.

query: How soon should I report a damaged item upon delivery?
reference_answer: Within 48 hours of delivery (and no later than 7 days).

query: What photos do I need to report a wrong item?
reference_answer: Clear photos showing the damaged or incorrect item, plus the shipping box and packing slip.

query: How many days do I have to request a price adjustment?
reference_answer: Within 14 days of your purchase date.

query: Do price adjustments apply to Black Friday sales?
reference_answer: No, flash sales, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and holiday doorbusters are excluded.

query: How many points do I earn per dollar in Northstar Rewards?
reference_answer: 1 point per $1 spent on eligible purchases (excluding tax and shipping).

query: How many points are needed for the Peak loyalty tier?
reference_answer: 1,500+ points per year.

query: What discount do I get with Auto-Deliver subscriptions?
reference_answer: 10% discount on every recurring order plus free standard shipping.

query: When do I need to cancel an Auto-Deliver subscription before renewal?
reference_answer: At least 48 hours before your scheduled renewal date.

query: Does Northstar Shop store my full credit card number?
reference_answer: No, Northstar Shop is PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant and never stores full credit card numbers or CVV codes.

query: How long does a GDPR personal data export take?
reference_answer: Exported within 15 days.

query: What should I try if 3D Secure OTP fails during checkout?
reference_answer: Disable ad blockers/VPNs, switch from mobile data to Wi-Fi (or vice versa), or use PayPal/Apple Pay.

query: How long does it take for a store pickup order to be ready?
reference_answer: Typically ready within 4 hours if placed at least 3 hours before store closing.

query: How many days will the store hold my BOPIS pickup order?
